36506-commercialized-prostitution-in-new.title: Commercialized Prostitution In New York City
36506-commercialized-prostitution-in-new.creator: Unknown
36506-commercialized-prostitution-in-new.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A parlor house or brothel is a building used exclusively for the business of prostitution. It derives its name from the fact that its inmates gather in the parlor to receive their guests. There is, however, an exception to the definition, inasmuch as some parlor houses in New York City are situated on the upper floors of buildings, the ground floors of which are used for legitimate business enterprises.

79699-the-fortune-hunters-and-other-stor.title: The Fortune Hunters And Other Stories

He had a square face and a small dark moustache, and, as he drew near, she became certain that his figure was familiar.

arxiv-1704-06504.title: Universal MBQC with generalised parity-phase interactions and Pauli measurements
arxiv-1704-06504.creator: Aleks Kissinger, John van de Wetering
arxiv-1704-06504.description: Abstract We introduce a new family of models for measurement-based quantum computation which are deterministic and approximately universal. The resource states which play the role of graph states are prepared via 2-qubit gates of the form exp ( − i π 2 n Z ⊗ Z ) \exp(-i\frac{\pi}{2^{n}}Z\otimes Z) .

arxiv-2012-04901.title: Asynchronous Guessing Subject to Distortion
arxiv-2012-04901.creator: Shigeaki Kuzuoka
arxiv-2012-04901.description: Abstract The problem of guessing subject to distortion is considered, and the performance of randomized guessing strategies is investigated. A one-shot achievability bound on the guessing moment (i.e., moment of the number of required queries) is given. Applying this result to i.i.d. sources, it is shown that randomized strategies can asymptotically attain the optimal guessing moment.

arxiv-2102-08240.title: SDSS-IV MaNGA: Blueberry Candidates Associated with LSB Galaxies − - Merger or Tidal Dwarf Systems ?
arxiv-2102-08240.creator: Abhishek Paswan, Kanak Saha, Suraj Dhiwar
arxiv-2102-08240.description: Abstract We report here our finding of two new blueberry galaxies using optical IFU spectroscopic data from the MaNGA survey. Both the blueberries are found to be compact ( < \textless 1 − 2 1-2 kpc) starburst systems located at the outskirts of Low Surface Brightness (LSB) galaxies.

arxiv-2401-09524.title: Size Winding Mechanism beyond Maximal Chaos
arxiv-2401-09524.creator: Tian-Gang Zhou, Yingfei Gu, Pengfei Zhang
arxiv-2401-09524.description: Abstract The concept of information scrambling elucidates the dispersion of local information in quantum many-body systems, offering insights into various physical phenomena such as wormhole teleportation. This phenomenon has spurred extensive theoretical and experimental investigations. Among these, the size-winding mechanism emerges as a valuable diagnostic tool for optimizing signal detection.

arxiv-2403-06116.title: Analytical evaluation of the effect of deterministic control error on isolated quantum system
arxiv-2403-06116.creator: Kohei Kobayashi
arxiv-2403-06116.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kohei Kobayashi. We investigate the effect of analog control errors which deterministically occurrs on isolated quantum dynamics. Quantum information technologies require careful control for preparing a desired quantum state used as an information resource. However, in realistic experiment systems, it is difficult to implement the driving Hamiltonian without analog errors and the actual performance of quantum control is far away from the ideal one.

arxiv-2408-03130.title: Inference Optimizations for Large Language Models: Effects, Challenges, and Practical Considerations
arxiv-2408-03130.creator: Donisch, Leo, 2 nd Sigurd Schacht, 3 rd Carsten Lanquillon
arxiv-2408-03130.description: Abstract Large language models are ubiquitous in natural language processing because they can adapt to new tasks without retraining. However, their sheer scale and complexity present unique challenges and opportunities, prompting researchers and practitioners to explore novel model training, optimization, and deployment methods.

arxiv-2506-04859.title: Sparse Autoencoders, Again?
arxiv-2506-04859.creator: Yin Lu, Xuening Zhu, Tong He, David Wipf
arxiv-2506-04859.description: Abstract Is there really much more to say about sparse autoencoders (SAEs)? Autoencoders in general, and SAEs in particular, represent deep architectures that are capable of modeling low-dimensional latent structure in data. Such structure could reflect, among other things, correlation patterns in large language model activations, or complex natural image manifolds.

arxiv-2510-21455.title: Towards Explainable Personalized Recommendations by Learning from Users’ Photos Journal: Information Sciences
arxiv-2510-21455.creator: Jorge Díez, Pablo Pérez-Núñez, Oscar Luaces, Beatriz Remeseiro, Antonio Bahamonde
arxiv-2510-21455.description: Abstract Explaining the output of a complex system, such as a Recommender System (RS), is becoming of utmost importance for both users and companies. In this paper we explore the idea that personalized explanations can be learned as recommendation themselves. There are plenty of online services where users can upload some photos, in addition to rating items.

arxiv-2602-15128.title: PolyNODE: Variable-dimension Neural ODEs on M-polyfolds
arxiv-2602-15128.creator: Per Åhag, Alexander Friedrich, Fredrik Ohlsson, Viktor Vigren Näslund
arxiv-2602-15128.description: Abstract Neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) are geometric deep learning models based on dynamical systems and flows generated by vector fields on manifolds. Despite numerous successful applications, particularly within the flow matching paradigm, all existing NODE models are fundamentally constrained to fixed-dimensional dynamics by the intrinsic nature of the manifold’s dimension.

pmc-10537509.creator: Joanna Skoczylas, Elżbieta Jędrszczyk, Kinga Dziadek, Ewa Dacewicz, Aneta Kopeć, Tao Feng, Gui-Guang Cheng, Lu Liu
pmc-10537509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Garlic is commonly used as vegetable or spice and as a herb in folklore as well as traditional medicine in many countries. The current study aimed to compare the chemical composition, antioxidant activity, and the content of selected polyphenolic compounds in cloves as well as leaves of winter garlic plants of the Harnaś and Ornak cultivars, which are of Polish origin. Garlic was grown from cloves for three years (2018–2020) in the experimental field of the University of Agriculture in Krakow, Poland.

pmc-10545702.title: Characterisation of strength and deformation characteristics of alkali-activated rice husk ash filler-assemblage perimeter rock
pmc-10545702.creator: Wenhua Zhao, Ruilin He, Qi Sun, Qi Gu
pmc-10545702.description: In this study, the strength characteristics, deformation characteristics and damage characteristics of three kinds of specimens, namely, surrounding rock, cemented paste backfill (CPB) and a surrounding rock-CPB combination, were studied by uniaxial compression testing using rice husk ash and slag as cementing materials, and the mechanical properties of the combination specimens with different height ratios were also analyzed.

pmc-11883896.description: IntroductionThe terrestrial orchid genus Nervilia is diagnosed by its hysteranthous pattern of emergence but is nested among leafless myco-heterotrophic lineages in the lower Epidendroideae. Comprising ca. 80 species distributed across Africa, Asia and Oceania, the genus remains poorly known and plagued by vague and overlapping species circumscriptions, especially within each of a series of taxonomically intractable species complexes.

pmc-12534168.description: Morphea is a chronic autoimmune condition characterized by sclerosis and scar‐like changes in the skin and underlying tissues. En coup de sabre represents a rare and severe linear variant of morphea, primarily affecting the frontoparietal scalp and forehead, with a higher prevalence among children and women.

pmc-12785809.title: Development and Application of a Polymerase Spiral Reaction (PSR)-Based Isothermal Assay for Rapid Detection of Yak (Bos grunniens) Meat
pmc-12785809.creator: Moon Moon Mech, Hanumant Singh Rathore, Arockiasamy Arun Prince Milton, Nagappa Karabasanavar, Sapunii Stephen Hanah, Kandhan Srinivas, Sabia Khan, Zakir Hussain, Harshit Kumar, Vikram Ramesh, Samir Das, Sandeep Ghatak, Shubham Loat, Martina Pukhrambam, Vijay Kumar Vidyarthi, Mihir Sarkar, Girish Pa

pmc-12903229.title: EpCAM activates the ERK-EGR1 signaling axis and promotes TNF-α-induced the progression of anaplastic thyroid cancer
pmc-12903229.creator: Chi-Chiu Lee, Yi-Jen Su, Sushree Shankar Panda, Chiung-Yi Chiu, Chung-Hsuan Wu, Tsai-Ming Lu, Pi-Chun Li, Yen-Lin Huang, Ruey-Long Hong, Shao-Hsi Hung, Cassian Yee, Stephen Y. Lai, Han-Chung Wu
pmc-12903229.description: BackgroundEpithelial cell adhesion molecule (EpCAM) is a pleotropic transmembrane glycoprotein comprising an extracellular domain (EpEX), a single transmembrane domain, and an intracellular domain (EpICD). For several types of cancer, high EpCAM expression is associated with tumor progression, metastasis, immune evasion, and overall poor prognosis.

pmc-13051589.title: Multi-omics analysis identified SPRR2D as a potential biomarker for tumor prognosis and immune microenvironment infiltration: a pan-cancer perspective
pmc-13051589.creator: Yuan-Xiang Shi
pmc-13051589.description: BackgroundClarification of the molecular mechanism of malignant tumor progression, identification of the key signaling pathways and molecules involved in the processes of invasion and metastasis, and identification of new targets and strategies for effective tumor treatment are extremely important for scientific research and clinical application prospects.

pmc-13059178.title: Correlation between mid-term intraocular pressure and aqueous flare value in micropulse transscleral cyclophotocoagulation: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13059178.creator: Mitsuya Otsuka, Nobuo Ishida, Gaku Ishida, Teruhiko Hamanaka, Ryota Akai, Yasuhito Nitta, Atsushi Hayashi
pmc-13059178.description: BackgroundMicropulse transscleral cyclophotocoagulation (MP-TSCPC) lowers intraocular pressure (IOP), but the mechanisms underlying its IOP-reducing effect remain incompletely understood. Although early postoperative flare elevation has been reported in association with IOP reduction, the relationship during the mid-term postoperative period has not been well characterized. In this study, the mid-term period was defined a priori as 3–18 months after surgery.

pmc-13190394.title: Accounting for health expenditures, migration, and CO₂ emissions in the EU: a bidirectional analysis
pmc-13190394.creator: Melissa N. Cagle, Yasin G. Gençer, Mahmut Ünsa Şaşmaz, Ahmet Özen
pmc-13190394.description: BackgroundMigration, health expenditures, and carbon emissions are critical policy concerns in the European Union. However, limited evidence exists on how these factors interrelate across diverse member states, and most existing studies examine only one pairwise linkage at a time, rely on non-EU settings, or employ methods that do not accommodate cross-sectional dependence and heterogeneous country dynamics.

pmc-13219208.title: Animal production under climate change: a global scientometric analysis of research structure, thematic evolution, and knowledge gaps
pmc-13219208.creator: Robson Mateus Freitas Silveira, Concepta McManus, Iran José Oliveira da Silva
pmc-13219208.description: Climate change is a major driver of transformation in livestock systems; however, existing reviews remain fragmented, often addressing environmental impacts or adaptation strategies in isolation, without systematically integrating the structure, evolution, and knowledge gaps of the field. This study addresses this limitation through a comprehensive bibliometric–scientometric analysis of global research on climate change and animal production.

pmc-13534518.title: KELIM及BRCA突变状态对晚期高级别浆液性卵巢癌中间型肿瘤细胞减灭术预后的影响
pmc-13534518.creator: Yuebo Li, Mengru Li, Xiuyun Zhang, Hanjie Xu, Jie Li, Hanyuan Liu, Cheng Peng
pmc-13534518.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的探讨CA125消除速率常数（CA125 elimination rate constant k, KELIM）对接受新辅助化疗联合中间型肿瘤细胞减灭术（neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by interval debulking surgery，NACT-IDS）的晚期高级别浆液性卵巢癌（high-grade serous ovarian cancer, HGSOC）患者疗效及预后的预测价值，并分析其与乳腺癌易感基因（breast cancer susceptibility gene，BRCA）突变状态的联合预后意义。方法回顾性纳入106例接受NACT-IDS治疗的晚期HGSOC患者。计算NACT期间的KELIM，以1.0为界分为高、低两组。比较两组临床病理特征、R0切除率及铂敏感率。采用Logistic回归分析R0切除的预测因素，采用Kaplan-Meier法和Cox回归分析无进展生存期（progression free survival，PFS）的影响因素。进一步根据KELIM与BRCA状态进行联合分层，分析各亚组的铂耐药复发风险。结果KELIM≥1组R0切除率高于KELIM<1组（77.1% vs 55.2%），差异有统计学意义（P=0.024）。多因素Logistic分析显示，KELIM是R0切除的独立预测因子（OR = 2.922，95% CI: 1.112～7.678）。生存分析显示，KELIM≥1组的PFS长于KELIM<1组（33.0个月 vs 18.0个月），差异具有统计学意义（P<0.001）。多因素Cox回归显示，KELIM≥1与PFS进展风险降低相关（HR = 0.481，95% CI: 0.280～0.826）；联合分层分析显示，“KELIM≥1且BRCA阳性”亚组未观察到铂耐药复发（0/21），与KELIM<1且BRCA阴性组相比较，其铂耐药复发风险较低（OR = 0.053，95% CI: 0.003～0.932，P = 0.006）。结论KELIM是预测NACT-IDS患者手术结局和PFS的有效动态标志物。KELIM与BRCA状态联合分层能更精准地识别铂耐药复发风险极低的“双重有利”人群，为晚期HGSOC的个体化治疗与风险分层管理提供重要依据。Keywords: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌, 中间型肿瘤细胞减灭术, 新辅助化疗, CA125消除速率常数K, BRCA基因 卵巢癌是病死率最高的妇科恶性肿瘤，其中晚期高级别浆液性卵巢癌（high-grade serous ovarian cancer, HGSOC）是最常见的亚型。因其早期症状隐匿，超过70%的患者确诊时已属晚期。对于肿瘤负荷大、伴有大量腹水或一般状况无法耐受初次肿瘤细胞减灭术（primary debulking surgery, PDS）的患者，新辅助化疗联合中间型肿瘤细胞减灭术（neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by interval debulking surgery，NACT-IDS）已成为标准治疗模式之一[1]。然而，患者对NACT的反应存在异质性，部分患者即使完成治疗，仍面临快速复发与铂类耐药的问题，导致预后不良。研究显示，尽管乳腺癌易感基因（breast cancer susceptibility gene，BRCA）突变患者通常对铂类药物更为敏感且生存期较长，但仍有部分患者出现耐药与早期复发[2-3]。因此，如何在治疗前或治疗早期准确评估患者对铂类药物的敏感性，成为指导临床决策、改善疗效的关键。 目前，肿瘤标志物 CA125是广泛应用的血清标志物，但其单点测定特异性有限[4-5]。You等[6]提出的KELIM，通过动力学模型定量评估化疗中肿瘤标志物CA125的清除速率，为预测疗效提供了新思路。尽管KELIM在PDS患者中的预后价值已得到验证，但针对NACT-IDS人群的研究仍有限，且较少将其与BRCA基因状态结合分析[7-12]。为此，本研究旨在通过回顾性分析106例接受NACT-IDS治疗的HGSOC患者的CA125动力学数据，评估KELIM对IDS后R0切除率、无铂间期（platinum free interval，PFI）、PFS及总生存期（overall survival, OS）的预测能力，并探讨其与BRCA状态的联合预后意义，为晚期HGSOC的风险分层与个体化治疗提供依据。 资料与方法 研究对象 本研究为一项单中心回顾性分析。选择2019年1月—2024年12月期间于本院妇产科接受治疗的晚期HGSOC患者106例。共筛查171例，按排除标准排除65例，最终纳入106例（图1）。所有患者均接受NACT后行IDS。NACT方案以铂类联合紫杉类为主，每3周为1个周期，通常完成3～4个周期后评估是否进入IDS，术后按残余病灶评估减瘤效果，定义R0为无肉眼残余，R1/R2为存在肉眼残余。BRCA 1/2检测来源于胚系和/或体细胞检测，将致病或可能致病变异定义为BRCA阳性（BRCA+），未检出致病或意义未明变异定义为BRCA阴性（BRCA－）。IDS后患者接受标准辅助化疗完成一线治疗；复发后按临床实践给予二线及后续治疗方案。 Study cohort enrollment criteria and data processing flowchart for advanced HGSOC
